source.name: Seattle Sounders FC: 'Sounders FC and the Puyallup Tribe of Indians' Emerald Queen Casino announce new naming rights deal, proudly introducing the Emerald Queen Casino Pitch at Lumen Field'
source.quote: most visibly logo placement on the right sleeve of all Sounders FC kits, with the primary kit featuring the EQC logo
source.note: Right-sleeve partnership announced 2021-03-24, running through 2027 (MLSsoccer.com). FOR SOCCER's February 2026 MLS jersey-sponsor list confirms the EQC/Puyallup Tribe logo is on the right sleeve of the 2026 kit.

source.name: FOR SOCCER: '2026 MLS Jersey Sponsors'
source.quote: media partner Apple, once again, will be on the left sleeve of every jersey

summary: All MLS clubs wear Adidas; Apple TV is on the left sleeve of every kit. Providence fronts the Sounders' primary shirt; the Emerald Queen Casino (Puyallup Tribe) logo is on the right sleeve.
